components.forcing: component * PWAT (a moisture-flux proxy, kg m-1 s-1)
components.unit_vectors: from static_geography_v1 fields coast_landward_* and terrain_uphill_*; wind u east, v north, direction of motion

coverage_mapping: after Stage 2 evidence is built and served, the coastal/orographic row may move from PLANNED to PARTIAL with the wording in protocol v3; never to IMPLEMENTED

labels.2019: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2019 FINAL TEST
labels.2025: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2025 FINAL TEST

gates.no_observation_in_forcing: forcing is computed before any observation is loaded; a test asserts the function signature accepts only forecast fields and static fields
gates.strata_partition_zone: for each zone-component the three strata add up exactly to the Stage 1 zone totals, which themselves reproduce the published evidence

immutability: any changed rule requires spec v2

inputs.q700: listed among the protocol's inputs but not used by the forcing formula (wind times PWAT); not read
inputs.snapshot: case dayK uses the forecast snapshot at lead 24*K hours (24, 48, 72) of the case's own initialization, the same convention as the regime classifier
inputs.track_A_sources: 2017 and 2018: data/processed/phase2a daily atmosphere_context NetCDF3; 2019: Phase 1F zarr store 'atmosphere' array, field order U850, V850, Q700, Z500, MSLP, PWAT

nature: Clarifies points on which protocol v3 section 8 is silent or ambiguous. It changes no protocol rule, threshold, scope or decision rule.

q3.fss: not reported (strata are scattered cell sets)
q3.gap_rule: analogue of the protocol rule: development interval excludes zero and the final-test point estimate has the same sign; chance counts reported; Q3 does not change the Stage 3 recommendation made by Q1 and Q2
q3.heavy_frequency_bias: forecast heavy events / observed heavy events in the stratum
q3.statistic: metric(strong) - metric(weak) per model, paired whole-case bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 26080, same resamples for every model and statistic)

resampling.extrapolation: none; all target cells lie inside the context grid
resampling.method: bilinear (scipy RegularGridInterpolator, linear), context grid to the 0.25 degree target cell centres

terciles.cut_points: numpy quantile (linear) at 1/3 and 2/3 of forcing, fitted per track, zone and component; saved in the evidence
terciles.degenerate: if the two cut-points coincide the zone-component is reported as undefined, not stratified

A.cases: all 258 cases of the Phase 2B 2017 training cache

B.cases: all 200 paired cases of the 2023 training population

terciles.pairs: every zone cell of the footprint in every fit case

title: Stage 2 execution specification (forcing-strength strata and Q3) under coastal/orographic protocol v3

zone_to_component.note: The protocol defines onshore for COASTAL and cross_barrier for OROGRAPHIC cells. For cells that are both, both definitions apply and are reported separately; no combined index is invented. OTHER has no defined component and is not stratified.
